# WO-197: Refresh the developer hub page
Status: open (local scope prepared; owner tracker/worktree preparation pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-builder
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3.0
Assigned to: Kai Nakamura
Source: WO-194 / `docs/vendor/CODEX_SITE_REFRESH.md`

## Goal
Give `/developers/` a clear, contemporary entry point for technical visitors while keeping the rest of the site stable.

## Acceptance criteria
- Apply the reviewed scoped foundation and original art where appropriate.
- Import `site-refresh.css` and wrap refreshed route content in `.site-refresh`; leave Header/Footer/Base untouched.
- Preserve accurate existing developer content, route links, metadata, and script-free CSP behavior.
- Make the primary path into the CLI and configuration references obvious; keep language concise and readable.
- Add focused built-output coverage for route presence, core links, and meaningful image alternatives.
- Verify 320/360/768/1280 CSS px, Windows 125%/150% display scaling, 200% zoom, keyboard access, D6 contrast (body >=7:1; other >=4.5:1), and >=44px tap targets.
- Audit every claim against D8; flag any claim outside the allowed list rather than rewriting it.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `web/src/pages/developers/index.astro`
- `tests/codex/test_cx_developer_hub_refresh.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
No global nav/footer, shared tokens, CLI/config pages, app, source data, claims, CSP, build config, dependencies, or release files.

## Required checks
- `cd web && pnpm build`
- `PYTHONPATH=src FREEMYID_REQUIRE_WEB_DIST=1 ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_developer_hub_refresh.py`
- `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_developer_hub_refresh.py`
- `pnpm check` from `web/`

## Check-in plan
Owner-prepared worktree after WO-203 is integrated on main with reviewed WO-195/196. Developer pages are the final page wave. Report exact checks and visual review in status.

## Notes and decisions
Keep page copy within approved project facts. No customer logos, testimonials, numeric outcomes, or competitor comparison.
